title: Implement FT-004 check-in and measurement persistence service
verify: Migration/model tests prove daily_checkins and manual_measurements use native UUIDs, restrictive FKs, allowed states, pH/EC validation, event_refs, and no cascading authority delete.

Service tests prove Boss and granted Engineer can create check-ins and measurements while Consultant, revoked grant, disabled membership, unauthorized Plant, wrong Farm, and archived Plant fail before persistence.
Freshness projection tests prove independent 24h analysis and 2h approval-input windows from PostgreSQL measurement rows, not timeline, UI Feed, photo manifests, or agent text.

Timeline-ref tests prove daily_checkin_recorded and manual_measurement_recorded are appended through the Timeline Event helper and append failure returns TIMELINE_APPEND_FAILED without successful runtime mutation.
Behavior specs FT-004-BHV-001 through FT-004-BHV-003 have direct executable traceability in focused tests.
evidence_required: FT-004 service authorization and rollback test output
constraints: Use the verified Foundation DB/session/Alembic path and existing ActorContext/Plant permission resolver; do not create parallel auth or persistence infrastructure.

Implement only FT-004 check-in, manual pH/EC, freshness projection, and minimal timeline append refs; do not implement photo upload, Plant history UI, agents, Safety Gate, action tasks, follow-up, or PWA UI.
Archived Plant and unauthorized Plant paths fail before persistence and write no successful timeline event.
Timeline events are audit/export refs only and cannot become mutable runtime authority.
invariants: PostgreSQL/read model remains the authority for check-ins, measurements, and freshness.
Fresh pH/EC evidence never authorizes physical action without Safety Gate and human approval.
Missing or stale pH/EC remains explicit and must not be invented or treated as fresh.
Secrets, auth material, raw SQL errors, provider payloads, and hidden reasoning never enter source_refs, event_refs, timeline events, logs, or evidence.
verification_targets: Inject persistence and timeline append failures and prove no successful check-in or measurement is claimed.
Trace FT-004-BHV-001 through FT-004-BHV-003 to concrete passing tests.
purpose: Create the authorized runtime data and service boundary for daily check-ins, manual pH/EC measurements, freshness projections, and audit refs before HTTP exposure.
success_outcome: FT-004 check-ins and manual measurements persist only through authorized active-Plant service calls, compute freshness from PostgreSQL, and record timeline refs without making timeline mutable authority.
anti_goals: No photo upload or catalog storage.
No agent output, Safety Gate, action task, follow-up, or PWA implementation.
No generic workflow engine or new authorization subsystem.

forbidden_scope: Plant history UI or timeline pagination
agent, Safety Gate, action task, follow-up, or PWA behavior
new auth subsystem or generic ACL engine
stop_conditions: TASK-018-T3-FT-003-W3 is not done or its ActorContext/Plant access evidence is contradicted.
The service cannot enforce Plant.status=active and can_operate in the same transactional authorization boundary as writes.
Freshness cannot be computed from PostgreSQL measurement rows.
Diagnostics or evidence contain secrets, auth material, raw SQL errors, provider payloads, or hidden reasoning.
